criteria.title: Build a competing-hypothesis dossier connecting the first invalid state to delayed crash or corrupt-output symptoms.
criteria.task: For two histories with the same final crash, construct competing extent, initialization, lifetime and capacity explanations and choose a discriminating observation before repair. Minimize the first violating prefix rather than the final symptom.
criteria.purpose: The crash site is the cause or one familiar symptom identifies the mechanism.
